verdict.rationale: Xero's JAX assistant explicitly reconciles transactions by connecting bank accounts and categorizing/matching transactions automatically (xero-docs-20, xero-docs-27), and the official MCP server (xero-docs-3, xero-probe-2) exposes accounting data for agent-driven workflows. However, there is no evidence of exception flagging, month-end close orchestration, or a structured 'ready for human review' output — the story's full end-to-end close workflow is not documented. Missing for 10: exception-flagging logic, month-end close checklist/workflow automation, and evidence of an agent completing a full close cycle rather than just transaction matching.
